fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on politics and public services in Greater Miami, including criticism of Jackson Memorial Hospital’s administration and alleged political influence over patient care; discussion of an expected heavy winter tourist season; coverage of Coral Gables municipal politics and staffing changes in transportation and city management; notes on Hialeah civic finances and taxpayer disputes; commentary on Red Cross hurricane-relief fundraising; reports and satire touching on bootlegging and liquor prices during Prohibition; and brief items on crime and business conditions, alongside entertainment, nightlife, sports, and society columns and advertisements.
